actual_scope: Prove the exact six-call cost of two coordinate swaps for arbitrary finite address dimension n>=2 and arbitrary scalar register count R>=2, with restored dirty roles.
scope_change_reason: The assigned card seeks a native escape. This bounded negative formal-model result instead resolves the two higher-dimensional questions in PR1495 using a row-write budget and subgroup projection; no native supplier is claimed.
bottleneck_link: Side result on the bit-mechanisms track: excludes address-spectator or dirty-role enlargement as a two-swap saving in this exact tariff. It does not discharge the selected supplier obligations or change kappa.
stop_rule: Stop after the uniform proof, exact finite controls, registered replay and publication checks. Do not extend into a larger word census or native construction round.
evidence: README.md gives the uniform proof; verify.py checks finite row-budget, parabolic-projection and full formal-endpoint fixtures with explicit failure controls. VERIFY.json registers normal and optimized replay.
